prompt: Create one exquisite photoreal editorial close-up photograph, portrait 4:5. For a premium Australian cleaning and home-care brand using light olive and beige. Close view of the generously rounded corner and seat edge of an oatmeal linen sofa, impeccably clean, touchable natural weave crisp and beautifully visible. The sofa occupies the top-left two thirds in a strong organic curve; below and right is thick warm beige wool carpet, immaculate dense tuft fibers shown in raking afternoon sunlight. Tiny glimpse of muted olive cushion near upper right edge, softly out of focus. Warm natural sunlight and gentle window shadow create sophisticated contrast and depth. Real tactile material study with medium-format macro photography, shallow depth of field, restrained fine film grain, creamy warm highlights, green-gray shadows. The foreground carpet fibers transition into soft focus nearest camera. Calm, expensive, tranquil. Asymmetric sculptural composition, lots of beautiful texture. No people, hands, tools, text, logo, watermarks, shiny plastic, floating dust, gimmicky sparkle, split screen, collage, or borders. Commissioned interiors magazine photograph, not 3D rendering.
